top.zh:
s16瑞士轮第一轮，hle战胜tes后，失心落魄的369走下赛场，一个人去洗手间整理心情，冰凉的水打在脸上，输比赛的心情还是这么复杂
“毕竟我只是上来顶一下的，怎么可能赢得了神王呢？”看着镜中的自己，369自嘲一笑，“还是洗把脸回去练烟位吧。”369低下头，再抬起时却发现身后多了一人，黄黑的队标，魅惑的眼镜，竟是刚刚击败自己的神王宙活！
“你来干什么，嘲讽我吗。”369后退一步，努力绷起表情。
“我没这种心情，我来这是为了别的事情。”宙活轻扫一眼旁边的69，刚刚的胜利似乎没有在他心中产生什么喜悦。
“……你什么意思？”369带着戒备。
“你没必要这样，被人不做期望的感觉很难受吧，明明自己也是职业选手。”宙活边说边走近369，直到把他逼到墙角
“你就不想变强吗？”，恶魔的低语在69耳边响起，“接受我的神王基因，然后去送走其他lpl战队，我不想看到他们出现在我面前。”宙活的眼中燃起危险的光，双手强行把住369的头，让他直视自己。
“不要！我是lpl选手，我是不会让你如愿的！”369奋力挣扎，可已经泯了太久的他在宙活手中显得毫无反抗能力。
“这可由不得你了！接住我的神王基因，然后去扫清你的同赛区兄弟吧！”
…………
“69！怎么还没洗完啊，大家都在等你呢。”匆匆赶来寻找69的哥哥走进洗手间，却只看到呆呆站在镜子前的369。
“哦，好，我知道了，走吧。”369转过身，沉默着往前走。
“……9哥，你没事吧，一把比赛而已，大家都知道你尽力了。”哥哥担心的望向369，只觉得他的背影有些陌生。
“我没事，走吧，明天还要打al呢，还有……”369停下脚步，缓缓回头，
“以后叫我神王。”

top.en: S16 Swiss Stage, Round 1. After HLE beat TES, a dejected 369 walked off the stage and went to the restroom alone to clear his head. Cold water splashed on his face, but the feeling of losing was still so complicated. 'After all, I was just a stand-in, how could I possibly beat the God King?' 369 laughed at himself in the mirror, 'Better wash my face and go back to practicing [~0:smoke duty].' 369 lowered his head, but when he looked up, he found someone behind him. The yellow and black team logo, the charming glasses—it was the God King Zeus who had just defeated him! 'What are you here for? To mock me?' 369 stepped back, trying to keep his composure. 'I'm not in the mood for that. I'm here for something else.' Zeus glanced at 369; the recent victory didn't seem to bring him any joy. '...What do you mean?' 369 asked, guarded. 'You don't have to be like this. It feels terrible to be someone nobody expects anything from, even though you're a pro player too.' Zeus walked closer to 369 as he spoke, until he had him cornered. 'Don't you want to get stronger?' The devil's whisper echoed in 69's ear, 'Accept my God King genes, and go send the other LPL teams home. I don't want to see them in front of me.' A dangerous light ignited in Zeus's eyes as he grabbed 369's head, forcing him to look him in the eye. 'No! I'm an LPL player, I won't let you get your way!' 369 struggled, but having been [~1:washed up] for too long, he looked powerless in Zeus's hands. 'That's not up to you! Take my God King genes, and go wipe out your brothers from the same region!' ... '69! Why aren't you done washing up? Everyone is waiting for you.' [~2:JackeyLove], who had rushed to find 69, walked into the restroom, only to see 369 standing blankly in front of the mirror. 'Oh, right, I know, let's go.' 369 turned around and walked forward in silence. '...Brother 9, are you okay? It's just one game, everyone knows you tried your best.' JackeyLove looked at 369 with concern, feeling his back looked somewhat unfamiliar. 'I'm fine, let's go. We have to play AL tomorrow, and also...' 369 stopped and slowly turned back, 'Call me God King from now on.'

notes.context: The Valorant controller role; 369 spent his break playing Valorant.
Used here to mean washed up.
Fans' nickname for JackeyLove.

top.zh:
那是一个至暗时刻，每当回想起S16首日，我都不禁感到一阵后怕，我相信当时的任何人可能万念俱灰，谁也不敢奢望夺冠的结局…
可结果…总让人出乎意料！
当被HLE推倒基地的那刻，我羞愧的望了下台下观众，那种从满怀期待到悲愤不平的巨大落差深深刺痛了我…
恍惚间脑海中突然出现一种声音：369，你不该止步于此…
我好像看到了第一次接触游戏就无所不能的那个自己！我好像看到了夜以继日拼命训练那个坚强的自己！在那一瞬间，我明白了一个道理：
如果不能夺冠，那我之前的的人生将毫无意义可言！
“想明白了？”旁边的人突然递了一根烟
“是的，我想夺冠…不，康哥，我一定要夺冠！”
“对咯，耍起嘛”
……
后来的故事就不用多说，当我和康康最后捧起冠军奖杯的时候，我明白了故事才刚刚开始……

 —— 《冠军之路的起点：从白家浩到369》

top.en:
That was a pitch-black moment. Whenever I think back to day one of [~0:Worlds], I can't help but feel a lingering sense of dread. I'm sure anyone back then must have felt utterly hopeless, never daring to dream of winning the championship...
But the outcome... always catches you by surprise!
When the Nexus was pushed over by HLE, I shamefully looked down at the audience in the crowd. That huge gap between high expectations and fierce injustice cut deep into me...
In a daze, a voice suddenly echoed in my mind: 369, you shouldn't stop here...
It was as if I saw my all-powerful self when I first touched the game! It was as if I saw that resilient self training day and night! In that instant, I understood a truth:
If I can't win Worlds, my life up to this point will be completely meaningless!
"Figured it out?" The person next to me suddenly handed over a cigarette.
"Yeah, I want to win Worlds... No, Kang, I have to win Worlds!"
"That's right, let's roll"
……
As for the rest of the story, needless to say, when KangKang and I finally lifted the championship trophy, I realized the story was only just beginning…… —— 《The Origin of the Road to Glory: From Bai Jiahao to 369》

notes.context: Fan terminology for the League of Legends World Championship.
